name: Rurouni Kenshin: Trust & Betrayal
original_name: Rurōni Kenshin -Meiji Kenkaku Rōman Tan- Tsuioku-hen (るろうに剣心 -明治剣客浪漫譚- 追憶編)
overview: Rurouni Kenshin: Trust & Betrayal details the origins of the man who would bear the name of Hitokiri Battosai long before he swore his oath not to kill and before he earned his reputation as an assassin. The young man's heart is divided between justice and corruption, while the fate of a nation rests on his actions.
